newsitem.title: USA: ARCO Alaska, Anadarko set Cook Inlet effort.
newsitem.headline: ARCO Alaska, Anadarko set Cook Inlet effort.

text.p: ARCO Alaska Inc and Anadarko Petroleum Corp have agreed in principle to form an alliance to explore the Upper Cook Inlet of Alaska, ARCO said.
The Atlantic Richfield Co subsidiary said the final agreement will be effective as of September 1, 1996.

It said Anadarko will manage an Anchorage-based exploration team consisting of geoscientists from both companies. Anadarko will serve as operator and earn a 50 percent share of ARCO's working interest in Cook Inlet leases by conducting new seismic surveys, completing other geological and geophysical studies, and drilling exploratory wells.

The two-year agreement, which covers 127,000 acres of ARCO's Upper Cook Inlet leasehold, does not include the Sunfish prospect or the Beluga River gas field, ARCO said, adding the financial terms are confidential.
